title: Self-Diagnosis and Self-Debiasing: A Proposal for Reducing Corpus-Based Bias in NLP
measurement_description: The paper measured stereotypical bias related to religion using the CrowS-Pairs dataset. This involves evaluating whether masked language models assign a higher probability to stereotypical sentences over anti-stereotypical ones. An example of racist bias against Muslims is also shown.
findings: The proposed self-debiasing method successfully reduced stereotypical bias related to religion in BERT-base, BERT-large, and RoBERTa-large models, as measured on the CrowS-Pairs benchmark. For all three models, the score, representing the percentage of times the model preferred the stereotypical sentence, decreased after applying self-debiasing.
